errors.unsupported: {{name}} is not a supported format. Use GeoJSON, CSV, KML or GPX.
errors.invalid: {{name}} could not be read. Check that it is valid {{format}}.
errors.noCoordinates: {{name}} has no latitude and longitude columns. Name them lat and lon (or latitude and longitude, Breite and Länge).
errors.projected: {{name}} uses projected coordinates (for example EPSG:25832 from QGIS). Export it with longitude and latitude in WGS84 (EPSG:4326) and try again.

examples.charging: Where could new EV chargers go in this area?
